purpose: Define each installed port-bound protocol service as a named logical protocol instance bound to a listener, with identity separate from port, route, socket and runtime session.

topics.name: Protocol Instance
topics.purpose: Define each installed port-bound protocol service as a named logical protocol instance bound to a listener, with identity separate from port, route, socket and runtime session.

semantics.identity_rule: Each protocol instance has an explicit stable logical identity.
semantics.type_rule: Protocol type such as REST, OSC or WebSocket is explicit.
semantics.listener_rule: Protocol instance references an exact named listener instance.
semantics.binding_rule: Port/address/transport belong to the listener binding, not protocol semantic identity.
semantics.route_rule: Routes/addresses/channels are child protocol bindings and do not replace protocol instance identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Protocol exposure or reachability grants no domain-operation authority.

invariants.rule: Protocol identity, named listener instance, route/address/channel binding and domain operation identity remain separate; protocol exposure never creates semantic ownership or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: runtime session becomes protocol instance identity

references.purpose: Protocol instances bind to named listeners.

prose.summary: Define each installed port-bound protocol service as a named logical protocol instance bound to a listener, with identity separate from port, route, socket and runtime session.
